Crime & Law · India

CJP activists detained near Jantar Mantar; founder criticizes action

Delhi Police detained Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das, and Ajinkya Shinde, associated with the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), near Jantar Mantar. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke criticized the detentions, questioning if hoisting the national flag at the protest site had become a violation of law and calling those who think so "traitors". Republic World reported that the detentions occurred as the individuals "attempted to breach Jantar Mantar".
